subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should the iOS app permanently replace the phone tab bar and Control hub with the shared sidebar drawer once its session and cron data are complete?
rationale: The implementation is a deliberate, wide navigation and information-architecture change; code review can identify correctness requirements but cannot choose the permanent iPhone product direction.

options.title: Approve after completeness fixes
options.body: Retain the unified sidebar direction, but require paginated or explicitly partial session and cron snapshots before landing.

options.title: Keep phone tabs
options.body: Retain the existing compact tab contract and limit shared-sidebar work to iPad or a narrower future design.

recommendation.title: Approve after completeness fixes
recommendation.body: Retain the unified sidebar direction, but require paginated or explicitly partial session and cron snapshots before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The related Control UI direction and this iOS implementation both originate with this contributor, so they are the clearest available routing point for the design decision.
